customPorts.description: Game (UDP) and web panel / map downloads (TCP)

editor.label: Admin password
editor.description: For "Join as Admin" in the server list and the in-game admin panel.

editor.label: Map
editor.description: A map of the chosen mode, e.g. mp_tdm_map_003 (Team Deathmatch).

editor.label: Server token
editor.description: Required. In the game open the multiplayer lobby, press Alt + ~ and type customserver.gettoken; the token is saved to Documents\Mount and Blade II Bannerlord\Tokens\DedicatedCustomServerAuthToken.txt. It expires after 3 months.

editor.label: Extra modules
editor.description: Folder names of modules uploaded to Modules, separated by commas (loaded after Native and Multiplayer). Players need the same modules.

editor.label: Server name
editor.description: Shown in the custom server list.

editor.label: Password
editor.description: Leave empty for a public server.

editor.label: Admin password
editor.description: For "Join as Admin" in the server list and the in-game admin panel.

editor.label: Map
editor.description: A map of the chosen mode, e.g. mp_tdm_map_003 (Team Deathmatch).

script.name: Prepare the server
script.description: Refuses to start without a server token and installs the .NET 6 runtime the server needs.

script.name: Bannerlord query
script.description: Reports the server online while its game port is bound (Bannerlord custom servers have no query protocol).

customLink.name: Web panel
customLink.description: The server's own admin panel (log in with the admin password).
